model_reference_point.source: windowed mean of TRAINING loss, steps 21000-26000, run full-triton-seed-113
model_reference_point.claim_boundary: Training loss used as a provisional stand-in for held-out BPB. The training run consumes 307,200,000 of 1,563,218,387 available train.u16 tokens (19.6% of one epoch) with no byte repeated, so memorization pressure is low and the two should be close -- but this is an argument, not a measurement. Replace with a real development.u16 evaluation before drawing conclusions.

reading.interpretation: The model reaches bzip2-class compression using roughly 1758x less context, and gzip-class using 64x less. It loses only to the compressor whose advantage is precisely long-range reuse. This is the signature ARCHIE_COURT_IV.md section 5 predicts: strong local modeling, structurally capped long-range reach.
